name: Planning a Complete Garage Renovation: Phase-by-Phase Project Timeline

step.name: Step 1: Structural and Slab Inspection
step.text: Your contractor examines the existing concrete slab for shifting or dampness, checks roof trusses and load-bearing framing, and measures clearances. This assessment confirms whether the foundation can support interior walls and ensures water intrusion is solved first.

step.name: Step 2: Design and Permit Filing
step.text: Detailed drawings are prepared, covering the floor layout, utility runs, insulation details, and window or door modifications. The permit package is submitted to your local building department, including applications for structural, mechanical, plumbing, and electrical trade work.

step.name: Step 3: Rough Framing and Envelope Preparation
step.text: The crew frames interior partition walls, window bucks, or closet enclosures using pressure-treated sill plates against bare concrete. Any alterations to existing exterior doors or headers happen now, creating the sturdy skeleton for the entire build.

step.name: Step 4: Utility Rough-Ins and Mechanical Work
step.text: Sub-contractors run required wiring circuits, plumbing supply lines, drain pipes, and HVAC ducting or mini-split lines through the open studs. Once all in-wall utilities are placed, municipal trade inspectors inspect and approve the rough work before anything is covered.

step.name: Step 5: Insulation and Drywall Finishing
step.text: Insulation meeting local energy codes is fitted into wall cavities and ceiling joists, followed by professional drywall hanging and taping. Finishers apply multiple coats of mud and sand everything smooth, creating clean, fire-safe interior surfaces ready for final paint, trim, and fixtures.
